description: Search and read the genMC knowledge base: how every studio, tool, button, limit and workflow works (skins, builds, agents and pairing, accounts and sharing, export, shortcuts, troubleshooting). Call it without arguments for the table of contents, with query to search (best matching articles with a snippet and the matching section), or with article (a slug from the contents or a search result) to read one article in full as Markdown. Links written as doc:<slug> point to other articles. Use it when you are unsure how a feature works, what a label in the studio means, or how to explain something to the user. Read-only; it never changes the studio.

article.description: Slug of the article to read in full, e.g. "connect-agent".

lang.description: Language of the articles: en (default) or de.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "secret link" or "export schematic".

name: genmc_docs
title: genMC knowledge base
